notes.title: Price discount
notes.notes:
Hello 
AstronTycoon price has been cut. Hope you may like that. 

Let me show what I am doing with your money.

You are helping create new game AstronTycoon II Ritual. It’s a full 3d village building simulator game. You can check first look on environment on YouTube. Release date is set to 2019. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Bzx3IiDVHnE

Thank you all for support.
Martin
